apply.text: You turn the cuff. One stitch sits a thread higher than the hem. Nothing else is amiss.

outcome.continuity_note: A spare linen cuff, resewn, whose hem will not hold one count. Looking moves the sense of it from wear toward a patient irregularity, and setting the count aside only makes the same stitch easier to find again.
outcome.inspect: Linen cuff, resewn close. The hem is even, unless one stitch is standing in bad light.
outcome.name: Resewn Cuff

apply.text: You unfold it. The motto is so even that the scant ticks seem a failure of your counting, not of the claim.

outcome.continuity_note: A folded tally slip whose sure printed motto outruns a few pencil marks. Inspection and use trade false comfort in that certainty for a colder recount of the shortfall. No crowd, authority, or later event is claimed.
outcome.inspect: A folded slip, printed in sure type: THE MATTER IS CLOSED. A few pencil ticks sit shy of that claim.
outcome.name: Consensus Slip

apply.text: You turn the peg a quarter. The case does not answer. A thin warmth stays on the thumb.

outcome.continuity_note: An ivory tuning peg, warm where its case is cool, with rosin where no string was wound. Inspection keeps to that discrepancy. Each turn repeats the give, a little tighter or a little late; thin composure meets a brief ordinary weight, while sharper notice almost counts a missed beat and leaves it unnamed.
outcome.inspect: The ivory peg is warm, though the case is not. Rosin clings where no string was wound.
outcome.name: Ivory Peg

apply.text: You sound the reed. It holds true for a breath, then slides flat by the exact hair of the velvet mismatch.

outcome.continuity_note: Musician-pocket motif only, not a reported finding: a case whose black reed overruns its velvet hollow by a hair. Inspection dwells on that fixed mismatch. Soundings change the pressure of the almost-true note with sanity, insight, charges, and state. Very low sanity may briefly treat the wrong note as a stable measure. No attention or later event is asserted.
outcome.inspect: A black reed lies a hair past its velvet hollow. The extra length is slight, and you dislike it.
outcome.name: Split Reed Case

apply.text: You align the card to the table. One corner lifts a hair, then settles. The square holds.

outcome.continuity_note: A blank square card whose only event is a crease that stays flatter than the hand expects. Inspect reports edges, right angles, and a lag that never becomes a height. Apply advances a fold count from 0 to 255: a first mismatch at ordinary insight can unsettle slightly, very high insight files the discrepancy as a limit of the viewing frame, and low sanity may find the repeated square briefly steadying. Geometric restraint only; no promised place or further access.
outcome.inspect: A square of stiff card. Four edges, four right angles, no mark on either face.
outcome.name: Folded Square Card

apply.text: The card revises your pose in a dearer hand. The pleasure has a small crack.

outcome.continuity_note: Original gilt lacquer card-case, Wildean only in polish and irony: the surface offers a dearer pose, then shows the price. Hooks vary by sanity, insight, charges, and state. First acceptance nicks composure; repetition bills it; low sanity or higher insight lets the kindness miss. No attribute, quest, or hidden fact. Supplied bard, sanity 100, and insight 0 are context, not a claimed history.
outcome.inspect: Flawless lacquer. The clasp already shows a more successful guest.
outcome.name: Gilt Revision Case

apply.text: You read the face that forbids this face. It is satisfied, having been read as the other one.

outcome.continuity_note: A thumb-sized gummed slip, printed on both faces, each face directing the reader to the other. Inspection and use answer with small reversals: the face obeyed is the face forbidden, and later readings swap which account counts as first. Repetition does not rewrite the type; it only makes stillness sound like a missed turn of the paper. The prose stays sensory and claims no quest, place, or effect beyond a slight sanity shift.
outcome.inspect: A thumb-sized gummed slip. Each face reads: the other side is the one to read. The gum is dry on both.
outcome.name: Other-Side Slip
